name: Asymmetric-clip PPO + plain MSE value
tagline: PPO clip with widened upper bound $1+2\epsilon$ for positive advantages and standard $1\pm\epsilon$ for negative; value loss is unclipped MSE.

key_hyperparams.name: pos_clip_mult
key_hyperparams.role: multiplier on upper PPO clip when $A>0$

key_hyperparams.name: value clipping
key_hyperparams.role: vs PPO baseline which clips value

diff_from_baseline: Differs from PPO baseline by widening only the upper clip for positive advantages and removing PPO's clipped value loss entirely; not AWR (no exp-advantage weighting) and not PPO-Penalty (no KL penalty).

name: Adv-weighted clipped PPO + adaptive KL
tagline: Multiplies PPO's clipped surrogate by exp(A/β) AWR weights with auto-tuned β plus an adaptive PPO-penalty KL term and a +0.01 entropy bonus.

key_hyperparams.name: β init
key_hyperparams.role: AWR temperature, auto-adapted from weight std

init_recovers: PPO (clipped surrogate) when w=1 and β_KL→0
diff_from_baseline: Stacks PPO baseline's clipped surrogate, AWR baseline's exp-advantage reweighting, and PPO-Penalty baseline's adaptive KL term into one update; AWR temperature β is auto-tuned to keep weight std around 0.5, which none of the three reference baselines do.

name: Dual-clip PPO + Huber value
tagline: Standard PPO upper clip plus a lower bound on negative-advantage loss at $-3A$ (dual clipping); Huber-2.0 value loss; entropy bonus 0.005.

key_hyperparams.name: dual_clip_coef
key_hyperparams.role: lower bound on per-sample loss when $A<0$

init_recovers: PPO baseline (no dual cap, MSE value, args ent) at dual_clip→∞ and δ→∞
diff_from_baseline: Adds dual clipping (Ye et al.'s lower bound at $-3A$ for negative-advantage samples) on top of PPO baseline, swaps clipped MSE value for Huber loss, and hard-codes 0.005 entropy; AWR baseline's weighted-regression loss and PPO-Penalty's KL term are absent.

name: RAPO: rectified-advantage PPO
tagline: Tanh-bounded action mean, sign-split policy loss with quadratic ratio rectifier on bad actions, log-ratio trust penalty, and advantage-magnitude-weighted (clipped) value loss.

key_hyperparams.name: neg_rectify
key_hyperparams.role: quadratic excess penalty on $r>1$ for negative advantages

key_hyperparams.name: action mean cap
key_hyperparams.role: soft bound on actor mean output

diff_from_baseline: Replaces PPO baseline's symmetric clip with a sign-aware loss (positive: PPO-min; negative: linear + quadratic rectifier), adds a sign-asymmetric trust-region term in log-ratio space, weighs the value loss by $|A|$, and bounds the actor mean — none of which appear in PPO, AWR, or PPO-Penalty.
